description: Use this when someone asks what size pool heater (BTU per hour) they need to raise the water a number of degrees Fahrenheit in a given time. Takes gallons, the temperature rise in °F and the hours (default 24), plus an optional buffer for surface heat loss (default 20 %, the same as the heater calculator on calculatepool.com). Returns the BTU/h required, the size with the buffer, the total BTU and the electric input of an equivalent heat pump. Not for heating cost per month or heater model recommendations.

buffer_percent.description: Extra capacity for surface heat loss while heating (default 20).

gallons.description: Pool volume in US gallons (from pool_volume if the user gave dimensions).

temperature_rise_f.description: Degrees Fahrenheit to raise the water.

name: heater_size

link.description: Page of calculatepool.com for the same calculation.

title: Pool heater BTU size
